name: fyt
description: FYT (Find Your Trainer) monorepo: admin console, mobile app, Cloud Functions and shared domain code.

scripts.test: npm test -w packages/domain -w apps/admin -w functions -w apps/mobile
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fyt --only firestore,storage "npm test -w tests/rules"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fyt --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:integration -w functions"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/domain -w functions -w apps/mobile -w tests/rules
